subject: StratusGrid marketplace seller onboarding — PO lane & intake forms
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <am@stratusgrid.io>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stratusgrid.io
Date: 2025-06-29T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace onboarding & PO lane for StratusGrid

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the intro form on the marketplace listing. We're excited to get StratusGrid live across AWS/Azure/GCP. Two quick asks to start the procurement intake: 1) a single point of contact and PO routing for Redwood Marketplace listings, and 2) confirmation of the required vendor forms (W-9, bank info, marketplace enrollment packet).

We're ready to send over our seller packet but want to route it correctly to avoid delays with our finance team. Can you confirm the PO email and whether Redwood will accept a consolidated PO for multi-region listings, or if separate POs are needed per cloud?

Appended: brief seller packet (see attachment stub).

--
Alex Moreno
Head of Partnerships, StratusGrid
am@stratusgrid.io
Attachment: StratusGrid_Seller_Form.pdf (application form, 2 pages)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <am@stratusgrid.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding & PO lane for StratusGrid

Alex — great to meet you (virtually). Short answers up front:
- PO routing: procurement@redwood.com is the canonical inbox for purchase orders; for marketplace listings we also route to marketplace-billing@redwood.com for activation handoffs.
- Consolidated POs: we can accept a consolidated PO that lists multiple cloud regions as line items; finance prefers a single PO where possible to accelerate provisioning.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Please upload the completed seller packet and W-9 to the Drive link below (or reply with attachments).
2) Ben will scope marketplace billing items and confirm the activation SOW.
3) Karthik will confirm any additional vendor intake forms required by our legal/procurement team.

Putting Ben and Karthik on this thread to pick up the paperwork and SOW side. Vanessa — FYI for marketplace partner enablement (we may want a short co-marketing blurb once live).

Drive link for vendor intake: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRstUvWxYz

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <am@stratusgrid.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-30T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding & PO lane for StratusGrid

Alex — welcome. Quick checklist from marketplace billing/procurement side:
- Required: Completed seller packet, signed W-9 (or W-8 if non-US), vendor bank details (ACH), and a copy of the proposed SOW for activation fees.
- Optional but helpful: sample PO format so we can pre-map line items to our billing catalog.

I attached a vendor intake checklist and our standard SOW template for marketplace activations (attachment stubs below). If StratusGrid can return the seller packet + W-9 by EOD Thursday we can queue the PO review and draft the activation SOW the following week.

Attachment stubs: Vendor_Intake_Checklist.pdf, Marketplace_SOW_Template.docx

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Alex Moreno <am@stratusgrid.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@stratusgrid.io
Date: 2025-07-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding & PO lane for StratusGrid

Thanks Ben — attaching the completed seller packet and W-9 now. A couple of notes:
- Bank details included for ACH; please confirm whether Redwood needs a vendor portal account or if email attachments suffice for first-time onboarding.
- We're planning a single PO for US regions (us-east/us-west), but will treat APAC/EU as separate items later.

Forwarding attachment stubs: StratusGrid_Seller_Form.pdf, StratusGrid_W-9.pdf

On the portal question: if there's a secure upload portal preferred for bank docs please share the link and we'll move the files there.

Regards,
Alex
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <am@stratusgrid.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding & PO lane for StratusGrid

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of procurement notes after a brief review:
- Vendor portal: we prefer vendor docs uploaded to our secure Drive folder (link above). For bank account details we can accept encrypted email or the portal upload; I'll send a secure DocuSign/encrypt link if you prefer not to use Drive.
- PO mapping: Ben and I reviewed the sample items. We're good with a consolidated US PO with line items for each region. I'll create a PO draft (SG-2025-0417) and route to procurement@redwood.com for formal issuance to your billing contact. Expect the draft by Wednesday.
- Legal: no additional vendor forms required beyond the seller packet and W-9 for this engagement; if anything else pops up we'll flag it immediately.

I'll follow up with the PO draft and a DocuSign link for the SOW. Vanessa — we'll coordinate the activation window once SOW is signed.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Attachment: SOW_StratusGrid_v1.docx (stub)
